weekly_slices_across_respondent_househol.lower_bound_rule: Use the minimum integer in each reported bin and assign zero to Do not know.
weekly_slices_across_respondent_househol.upper_bound_reason: More than 12 slices is open-ended with positive count; Do not know is also unbounded.

interpretation_limits: Respondent estimates of weekly household fresh-bread waste, not measured slices or mass.
This survey does not identify purchasers of the separate 736 g bread in the LCA.
These historical responses are not a linked or prospective field baseline.
No intervention, comparator, or causal effect is observed here.
Ranges assign Do not know responses to endpoints; they are not confidence intervals.
